name: sosfiltfilt
comment: N/A (definite): MATLAB R2025b has no top-level sosfiltfilt() -- the equivalent operation is filtfilt(sos, 1, x). Numkit ships sosfiltfilt(sos, x) as a public function that bit-identically matches scipy.signal.sosfiltfilt and is used internally by lowpass/highpass/etc. Definite N/A vs MATLAB top-level.
